parts:

Chong

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: formative latent variable with binary indicators
parts:
Chong--
It depends on what you want to do with such a variable. If you want to do this with factor model software like lavaan, then the easiest way might be to leave your four dichotomous observed variables as exogenous predictors, and then infer their joint influence on some other variable. But it might be that you want to use software for estimating composite-based models, such as the cSEM package.
